units.source_text: 所以，心脏的鼓动不能使他放心，他啃指甲。

en.t: And so the beating of his heart could not put him at ease; he bit his nails.

units.source_text: 脑波的节奏不能使他满足，他抽香烟。

en.t: The rhythm of his brain waves could not satisfy him; he smoked cigarettes.

units.source_text: 性交不能使他感到充实，他的腿下意识地晃动。

en.t: Sex could not make him feel fulfilled; his leg shook unconsciously.

units.source_text: 呼吸、步行、内脏的蠕动、每天的时间分配、每七日一个礼拜天，

en.t: Breathing, walking, the peristalsis of the internal organs, the daily allotment of time, one Sunday every seven days,

units.source_text: 每四个月重复一次的学期期末考试，谈不上使男人放心，反而成了新的强迫症。

en.t: and the term-end examinations repeated every four months, far from setting the man at ease, became new compulsions instead.

units.source_text: 不久，他抽烟一天比一天厉害起来，还与囤积指甲污垢的女人一起，胡乱寻找世人眼睛够不到的地方，

en.t: Before long, he was smoking more heavily day by day, and together with a woman who hoarded the dirt from under her nails, he recklessly searched for places beyond the reach of other people's eyes,

units.source_text: 大汗淋漓地沉浸于梦魇中，当终于发现自己开始呈中毒状态时，

en.t: sweating profusely as he sank into a nightmare, and when at last he discovered that he was beginning to show signs of addiction,

units.source_text: 他幡然醒悟地觉察到：周围只有无比单纯的圆周运动周期所支撑的天空，

en.t: he came to himself with a start and realized that around him there was only a sky sustained by an utterly simple cycle of circular motion,

units.source_text: 以及1/8mm波长所支配的沙丘地带。

en.t: and a region of dunes governed by a wavelength of 1/8 mm.
